job.job_description:
We are looking for a GenAI Platform Engineer with 3-6 years of experience in LLM-based systems, cloud platforms, and MLOps workflows. The role involves supporting deployment, fine-tuning, and infrastructure management of GenAI workloads across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Responsibilities
Support deployment and management of LLM-based systems in cloud environments.
Assist in prompt tuning, versioning, and model evaluation.
Work on CI/CD pipelines for model deployment and updates.
Support infrastructure setup using Docker and Kubernetes.
Monitor performance and assist in troubleshooting GenAI workloads.
Mandatory Skills
Python, SQL, AWS/Azure/GCP, LLMs, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
Good to Have
Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLflow, Bash scripting, NoSQL
